Commentary.Commentary: Australia now lead by 155 runs. We're still only in the second day of this match. They hold all the cards and are primed to set a mammoth target for the Indians. The hosts will have to pull off a miracle, to say the least, to stand a chance of getting something out of this match now. Stay tuned as the action is about to resume shortly.

India have only themselves to blame. They succumbed under pressure and just capitulated. Lost 4 wickets in the space of 8 deliveries, should say everything right then and there. The turning point was the wicket of KL Rahul. After that, it went all downhill for the home side. This would be one of their worst performances, and what'll disappoint them is that it was in their own backyard.

A thumping, thumping performance from the Australians! My, oh my... Who would have seen this coming, eh? The main dominator here, however, was unexpectedly Steve O'Keefe. The spinner took 6 wickets and ran right through the Indian batting order. But, what will delight Steven Smith even more is the fact that his pacers did the job for him at crucial junctures. First Hazlewood, then Starc and then Lyon joining in as well. It was a demolishing display.

OUT! INDIA HAVE BEEN BUNDLED OUT FOR 105! If one would have said this before the start of Day 2, nobody would've believed it! Tosses this one around off, Yadav dances down the track wanting to go over long on, but it takes a thick outside edge and Smith takes a good catch at first slip. INDIA TRAIL BY 155 RUNS!

The ball has raced away to the fence but that won't be counted. It turned a long way and went down the leg side, off the thigh pad, and then to the fine leg boundary. But since Ishant Sharma did not offer a shot, it's considered as a dead ball.
Umesh Yadav stays back and punches it to mid off for one.
Lyon bowls this on a shorter length once more, Umesh defends it back rocking back.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Flatter ball around off, Sharma whips it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Ishant pushes it to covers and runs one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sharma blocks this tossed up delivery!
Yadav flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Ishant Sharma is the last man in for the Indians.
Early drinks have been called!

OUT! Fifer for SOK! Some might question the shot Jadeja played but he had to go for it given the situation of the match! Tosses this one around off, Jadeja comes down the ground wanting to clear the long on fence. But he hasn't connected it well. Starc gets under it to take a calm catch! India have lost their nine wickets and trail by 159 runs!
Fullish delivery, on middle Jadeja prods forward and buries it right under his eye line!
Umesh plays the backward flick to this shortish delivery!
Umesh tries to sweep this looped up delivery and misses! Gets hit on the right shoulder.
Umesh buries this floated delivery right in front of the FSL!
Jadeja flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Jadeja tries to cut this tossed up delivery, but is beaten because of the bounce.
Angling down the leg side, Umesh tucks it through fine leg and runs one. India have managed to reach the 100-run mark!

NOT OUT! Successful review! Steve has bamboozled India totally here. There were apprehensions about his selection but he's put them to rest. Jadeja tries to sweep and misses. Replays indicate that it came off the southpaw's forehand. Jadeja gets a reprieve.
Ravindra Jadeja has been caught at leg slip and given out. He thinks otherwise and takes the review against the decision.
Flatter and on middle, Jadeja flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, around off, Umesh drives it through mid off for a single.
Umesh Yadav is next in to bat for India.

OUT! A MS Dhoni-esque stumping that from Wade! Steve makes Jayant leans forward to defend it and he does. However, he's beaten on the turn, Wade collects it and whips the bails off. Steve gets his fourth! Replays show that Yadav's back foot is on the line and he has to depart! The Indian fans cannot believe it. Australia can bundle India out under 100 here!
A stumping appeal against Jayant Yadav is taking upstairs to the third umpire. Matthew Wade seems quite confident he's got his man.
Short and flatter, Jadeja tucks it through fine leg for a single.
Jadeja comes forward and defends it in front of the FSL.
Jayant goes forward to defend but it raps his pads and Marsh thinks its a catch and goes for it, fluffing it in the end!
Slower through the air around off, Jayant knocks it back to the bowler.
Floated delivery outside off, Jayant drives it through covers for a brace.
Tosses this one on middle, Jayant blocks it with his front pad.
Two short legs are in place now...
Looped up delivery, on middle Jayant drives it to mid on.
Tosses this one around off which spins back sharply, Jayant looks to defend but pulls out very late. It raps his thigh pad and goes towards the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Jadeja tries to flick but misses and it hits his pads.
Jadeja goes forward to this tossed up delivery and buries it.
Jadeja strides forward and defends it.
Jaddu gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards the off side.
Tossed up delivery, around leg, Jadeja knocks it back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Jayant leans forward to block this, it hits his pads and lobs in the air for a bit. Cries of catch emerge, but it lands safely.
Looped up delivery, Jayant dead-bats it!
Jayant Yadav is the next batsman in for Australia.

OUT! The hosts are falling like nine pins. Handscomb takes a screamer at short leg! Lyon tosses this one on middle, Ashwin goes back to defend it. He blocks it but it bounces on his right shoe and goes towards the short leg, who dives to his right to take a one handed catch! The Australians think it's out and the umpire takes the referral; the soft signal is out. And the replays indicate that the catch is clean! Four wickets have fallen off eight deliveries. The Australians are delighted and why not!
It's gone upstairs again. An appeal for a catch against Ravichandran Ashwin is referred upstairs by the umpire. The soft signal is once again out.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Ashwin defends this tossed up delivery towards the leg side.
Ravindra Jadeja walks into the middle next.

OUT! INDIA ARE FALLING APART! It's not Starc not Lyon but O'Keefe who's creating havoc! It was the bounce that surprised Saha here. Tossed up delivery, Saha stays on his back foot to defend it, but it bounces a bit more. It hits the outside of his bat, Wade fails to grab it, but Smith grabs it on the rebound. Three wickets off one over and the match has turned on its head!
Tossed up delivery, on middle, Saha defends it.
Wriddhiman Saha is the next batsman in.

OUT! WHATTAY CATCH! Tossed up delivery, around leg, Rahane looks to flick but it turns very late and takes the leading edge. It flies towards Handscomb at second slip who takes a sharp low catch. Jinx thinks that the catch was not clean and holds his ground. However, the replays show that the catch was valid. Suddenly, India have lost half their side!
Ajinkya Rahane has been caught at second slip. But he has stood around to check if the catch has been taken cleanly or not. The soft signal is out.
Floats this on middle, Ashwin goes back and drives it through covers for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the next man in to bat.

OUT! What has happened here? Rahul has been caught and is on the ground holding his left shoulder. The physio is out and Rahul seems to be in extreme pain. Coming back to the delivery, it was a floated delivery, around off, Rahul comes down the track wanting to clear the long off fence. But he miscues and the ball goes high up in the air. Warner runs to his left, gets under it and catches it calmly. A loose shot from Rahul and he pays the price for it!
Full delivery, Rahul leans forward and defends it!
Steve O'Keefe returns to the attack.
Rahane cuts this tossed up delivery to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
DROPPED! Turn and bounce! Rahane goes back to tuck but it bounces more than he expected. It hits his gloves and goes towards Warner at leg slip, who gets his hand to it, but fails to hold onto it.
Rahane works it around towards the leg side.
50-run stand between Rahul and Rahane!
Good cricket this from India! Bowls this outside off, Rahul pushes it towards covers and sets off for a single. They complete it easily in the end.
Lyon, from round the wicket, bowls a floated delivery, Rahul defends it towards the leg side.
Short of a length ball, outside off, Rahane decides to go after it. Goes for the wild slash but doesn't connect.
Short delivery, outside off, Rahane arches back to leave it alone.
Back of a length delivery, around middle and leg, Rahane hops a bit and blocks it.
Full delivery around off, Rahul strides forward and defends it towards covers. Good running from both the batsmen as they steal a single.
On a length outside off, Rahul shoulders his arms.
FOUR! Full delivery, outside off, Lokesh stays in his crease and creams it through covers with complete authority. Shaun Marsh chased it from sweeper cover but failed to cut it off.

Sharp turn! Rahane leans forward to defend this floated delivery, but it takes the inside edge and goes towards Handscomb at short leg. It lands just short of him as he dives to his right to catch it.
Full delivery, on middle, Rahane uses his feet and drives it to mid on.
Sprays this towards the leg side, Rahane goes back and tucks it towards the leg side.
Floated delivery, around off, Rahane rocks back and pushes it back to Lyon.
Tosses this on middle and leg, Rahane camps back and blocks it onto the pitch.
Fullish delivery around off, Rahane lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack!
Back of a length delivery, around middle and leg. Think Rahul expected it because he did well to get out of its way!
Good length delivery around off, Rahul gets forward and drives it towards covers.
Rahul blocks this length delivery which was on the sticks.
FOUR! And again, what is Rahul doing there? Starc bowls a full length ball outside off, Rahul slices it and it goes past the diving gully fielder for a boundary!
Full delivery, around middle and leg, Rahul defends it.

FOUR! A lucky stroke this! Full delivery, outside off, Rahul throws his bat at it and it takes the edge and goes right through the gap between second slip and gully for a boundary. A loose shot this from Rahul after getting to his fifty!
Rahane leans forward and blocks it towards the off side.

Fifty for KL! Tossed up delivery around off, Rahul eases it down to long off and runs one. A good innings this from the Karnataka batsman. Notched up his 2nd fifty in this format and he's done it rather confidently today. Needs to carry on to score a big one now.
Steve tries to flight the ball but it ends up being a full toss. Rahane knocks it through mid off for a single.
Rahane gets forward and buries this floated delivery right onto the pitch.
Full delivery, which spins away, Rahane was aware and leaves it alone.
Flatter and shorter, Rahul camps back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this on a length, around middle and leg, Rahane pushes it towards covers.
On a length delivery, outside off, Rahane shoulders his arms.

Uncharacteristic shot from Rahane. Starc bangs this short, Rahane gets on his toes and tries to slash, but doesn't connect well, the ball lands well ahead of the chasing backward point fielder. They run a brace.
Length delivery, swinging away, Rahane stands firm in his crease and knocks it back to Starc.
Bowls this marginally short around off, Rahul opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards covers. One run added to the total!
Back of a length delivery, around leg, Rahul flicks it towards square leg.
Mitchell Starc will bowl from the other end.
Rahane leans forward and dead-bats this floated delivery.
Rahane offers a front foot defense.
FOUR! Short and slightly outside off, Rahane makes room for himself and cuts it past backward point for a boundary. Delightful stroke, that.
Short and flatter, Rahane gets his front foot ahead and lets it through.
Slower through the air, around off, Rahane lunges forward and buries it.
Sprays this down the leg side, Rahane just knocks it towards mid-wicket.

The Aussies are marching onto the ground. KL Rahul and Ajinkya Rahane too have arrived at the crease. Gripping session awaits us and we are more than happy to bring it to you. Steve O'Keefe will kick off the second session for Australia.
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Since then, Rahul and Rahane have ensured that they bat through to lunch. But it is this partnership that is very crucial for the hosts. The visitors have bowled extremely well. Steve O'Keefe managed to extract some turn and is looking dangerous. Can the visitors continue their good show or will Rahane and Rahul steady the innings? Do join us in a bit for the second session.

Australia have dominated this session thoroughly. The Indian openers, Murali Vijay and KL Rahul started cautiously and it seemed like they were in control. But Josh Hazlewood in his first over removed Vijay to bring Pujara at the centre. And as expected, it was Mitchell Starc who was the thorn in the hosts' flesh. He struck twice in his comeback spell to put India on the back foot. Among his victims was the home side's captain Virat Kohli, who had his first duck in India.
Josh bowls a full length delivery, Rahul drives it down the ground. The mid on fielder runs across to make a sharp save. AND THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!
On a length, angling back in, Rahul blocks it towards the leg side.
Good length delivery, on middle, Rahul goes back and buries it right under his eye line.
Fuller length delivery, around middle and leg, Rahul jams it to short mid-wicket.
Length delivery, outside off, Rahul gets his front foot ahead and pushes it towards covers.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Rahul gets on his toes and punches it towards mid-wicket.
Rahane has offered a front foot defense on this occasion.
Beautiful! Steve lures Rahane to come forward to defend and beats him on the turn.
Rahane has defended it with total control.
Rahane tries to cut this floated delivery, but it takes the inside edge and hits his back pad. A risky affair that!
Tossed up delivery, around off, Rahane drives it towards covers.
Slower in the air, Rahane goes forward and pushes this back to the bowler.
Good length delivery, nipping back in, Rahul knocks it back to the bowler.
Slower one, a length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Rahul was aware and blocks it onto the pitch.
Good length delivery, around off, Rahul drives it towards mid off.
Full delivery, around off, Rahane flicks it using his wrists. A bit of sloppy fielding from Handscomb at short mid-wicket allows the batsmen to run through. One run added to the total!
Back of a length delivery, around off, Rahane hops and defends with one hand right onto the pitch.
Bowls a length delivery, angling back in, Rahane is rock solid in defense.
A full toss on offer, Rahane eases it down through mid off for an easy single.
Drifting down the leg side, Rahul works it around through backward square leg. One run added to the total!
Bowls this on the leg stump line, Rahane flicks it through square leg. They run a single.
Full delivery, spinning back in, Rahane drives it to the cover fielder.
Floated delivery around off, Rahane goes forward and pushes it towards covers.
There's a slight delay in play as it seems like there's been a short circuit near the mid-wicket fence. The groundstaff has come to the rescue with the fire extinguishers and now, all is well.
Sprays this down the leg side, Rahul tickles it fine with soft hands and they take a single.
Steve O'Keefe is back on to bowl.
On a length, nips back in a bit, but it is in the fifth stump line and Rahane lets it through. The Australians are in total command here.
Good length delivery, angling back in, Rahane waits for it and defends it with total control.
Short of a length delivery, around off, Rahul gets over the ball and cuts it through covers for a single.
On a length, outside off, Rahul has no reason to play at it.
Back of a length delivery, Lokesh punches it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Rahul welcomes back Josh with a boundary. Overpitched delivery, around off, Rahul lunges forward and drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary!
Josh Hazlewood is back into the bowling attack.
Rahul drives this tossed up delivery through covers for an easy single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Tosses this one around off which goes back and Rahul blocks it with full face of the bat.
Rahul dead-bats this looped up delivery.

Floated delivery, around off, Rahul leans forward to defend. It hits his bat and pad, and Wade whips the bails off without the ball in his hands. Goes up, but I think he should be aware of the rules there.
Tossed up delivery around off, Rahane rocks back and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Once again the physio is out have a look at KL Rahul. Maybe he's feeling nauseous again. He's getting some fluids in him and having a banana as well.
Angling down the leg side, Rahane flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Starc goes round the wicket and bowls a full delivery, Rahul gets behind the line of the ball and knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Glorious shot that! Good length delivery outside off, Rahul goes forward, opens the face of the bat and places it through covers for a boundary. No need to chase that!
No ball! Length delivery, on the pads, Rahul blocks it towards the leg side. And Starc has overstepped, he'll have bowl this delivery again.

Fullish delivery on off, Rahane lunges forward and drives it towards Warner at mid off who misfields. Rahane sets off instantly, Rahul is a bit tentative but the former forces the latter and they cross through. A single taken.
On a length, outside off, Rahane shoulders his arms.
Bowls a full delivery around off, Rahane pushes this with control towards mid off.
Lands this short, Rahul rocks back and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Rahul defends this off the back foot.
FOUR! Rahul unleashes the reverse sweep. Hits it past the backward point fielder for a boundary. Brings up India's 50 with that shot.

Chance? Oh yes! Looped up delivery, Rahane goes forward to defend but it takes the inside edge of his bat, raps his pads and flies towards Warner at leg slip. He jumps in the air but the ball beats him. Tough chance. They run a single.
Rahane buries this floated delivery towards the leg side.
Tosses this one outside off, Rahane blocks it towards backward point.
Starc bangs this short, hip height, Rahul hops and flicks it towards mid-wicket. Rahane looks for a single but Rahul declines it.
Shortish delivery, around off, Rahul gets on his toes and blocks it towards covers.
Short of a length delivery on off, Rahul moves out of its way and lets it through.
Length delivery, around leg, Rahul moves across a bit and blocks it towards the off side.
Full delivery, around off, Rahul pushes this towards mid off.
Back of a length delivery, way outside off, Rahul leaves it alone.
Floated delivery around off, Rahane leans forward and buries it right under his eye line.
Bowls a full delivery around off Rahane defends it towards the leg side.
Looped up delivery, spins back in sharply and hits Rahane on the pads.
Shortish delivery, Rahul goes back and glances it through fine leg for a single.
Rahul flicks this floated delivery towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Rahul dead-bats it.
Yorker length delivery, Rahane stays in his crease and digs it out towards the off side. An outstanding over this from the Australian speedster. A double wicket maiden!
Length delivery outside off, Rahane shoulders his arms.
Ajinkya Rahane is the new man in.

OUT! Supreme bowling this from Starc. He's dismissed India's captain Kohli for a nought. It is his first duck in India. Fullish delivery, way outside off, Kohli leans forward wanting to drive and edges it to Handscomb at first slip who takes a good low catch. There was no need to play at it as it could have been left alone. India are in a bit of a trouble and the Australians are delighted. Kohli has to wait near the boundary line because Rahane wasn't ready. But the vice captain has arrived and off he goes to the pavilion.
Good length delivery, going away, 145kph, Kohli leaves it alone.
The Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, is next in at No.4.

OUT! Wow what a ball, surprised Pujara. Back of a length delivery, around off, Pujara was neither forward nor back and flirts with it. Ends up gloving it to Wade. A superb delivery from Starc and gets the result for it. The crowd is suddenly buzzing because you know who is going to arrive at the centre!
Length delivery, around off, Pujara drives it towards mid off.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
Short and flatter, Rahul knocks this towards mid on.
Lands this short Pujara rocks back and flicks it through square and runs one.
Pujara blocks it towards short leg.
A loud appeal for LBW as Pujara leans forward to defend. But there was bat involved and the umpire turns it down.
Tossed up delivery, around middle, Rahul gets it off his outside edge towards covers for a single.
Floated delivery, spinning back in, Rahul gets across and knocks this towards mid on.
Josh bangs this short around off, Pujara defends it off his back foot towards covers.
Bowls another length ball outside off, Pujara lets it go through to the keeper.
Short of a length delivery nipping back in, Pujara flicks it towards mid-wicket for no run.
On a length, around middle and leg, Pujara leans forward and watchfully defends it.
Josh gets good shape there. Length delivery, going back in, Pujara gets his front foot forward and pushes this towards covers.
Length delivery, way outside off, Pujara sees it go to Wade who collects it easily.
Rahul pushes this floated delivery towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery, Rahul gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
Rahul gets on the back foot and blocks this looped up delivery towards the leg side.
Looped up delivery, on off, Rahul knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautiful shot that! Full delivery around off, Rahul lunges forward and drives through the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery, spinning back in, Rahul moves across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Nathan Lyon is brought into the attack.
Bowls a length delivery again around off, Pujara prods forward and defends it towards the off side.
Good length delivery, going back in, Pujara leans forward and drives it towards mid on.
On a length outside off, Josh gives Pujara no reason to play at it.
Length delivery, in the corridor of uncertainty, but CP knows where his off stump is and leaves it alone.
Short of a length delivery, around off, Pujara gets on his toes and defends it.
FOUR! Fullish delivery, nipping back in, Pujara gets his front foot ahead, uses the pace and flicks it through square leg. The fine leg fielder hares across to save it but it beats him easily.
Lands this a bit short, KL camps back and blocks it back towards the bowler.
Tosses this one around off, KL Rahul leans forward and defends.
Early drinks have been called because of that. Rahul will continue...
There seems to be a problem with KL Rahul's left shoulder and he is getting medical attention. He's clearly struggling at the centre.

SIX! BANG! That's outta here! Goes dead straight down the ground and connects it very well. It's loopy, it's full and it's in his slot, Rahul charges down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Darts this on the pads, square leg is quite empty so Pujara just nudges it there for an easy single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a fuller length, O'Keefe drifts this one in from around off, Pujara drives it back down the track to the bowler.
Length ball just outside off, tries to play at it with a straight bat but gets a bottom edge behind which goes past the off stump.
Short of a length delivery into the body, Rahul rises and works it away to square leg.

Beautiful! Excellent length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Rahul initially was going to play at it but then withdraws his bat inside the line. KL was a bit squared up there as he tried to play at it.
Angles in a very full delivery, on middle and leg, Rahul leans ahead and dead-bats it into the track.
Just back of a length, outside off, Rahul looks to have a feel for it as he plays away from his body but is unable to make any connection on it.
Full and angling in on middle and leg, KL picks it off his pads and flicks it straight to the square leg fielder.

Shouts for a leg before which are turned down, and rightly so. Good call by the umpire. Slower through the air on middle and off, Pujara comes forward to block, gets an inside edge onto his pads and hence the lbw appeals were turned down.
Full around off, this is pushed away to to mid off for nothing.
Two slips in place for Pujara.
Pitched on a length, turning away from the batsman, he plays it with an angled bat down to third man for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, comes forward to bury it into the track.
Quite full on middle stump, Rahul clears his front leg and plays it back to the bowler.
Drifting in from around off, on a full length, it's driven to mid off by KL Rahul.
Length delivery around off, Pujara defends it from within his crease. Brings us to the end of an excellent first over from Josh Hazlewood.
India's one down Cheteshwar Pujara comes out at the centre. A short leg has been deployed. A flurry of short deliveries can be expected.

OUT! HAZLEWOOD STRIKES! Gets a wicket and too in his very first over. Shows just what a disciplined bowler can do. Bowls it marginally ahead of a length, outside off, Murali Vijay has no choice but to play at it as it's too close to him. He edges it and it's taken comfortably by Matthew Wade behind the stumps. Early breakthrough for Australia, just the wicket they wanted.
On a good length, outside off, Vijay with a watchful leave.
Keeps it on the fuller side, just outside off, another solid front foot block.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Vijay leans ahead and blocks it down on the off side.
Instantly gets this to come back in to KL Rahul, it's on a length as the batsman tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Bowling change for the Aussies. Josh Hazlewood is brought into the attack!
Floated up outside off, turning away from the batsman a touch, it's left alone.
Loopy on a fuller length, it's pitched outside off as Vijay pushes it to the cover region.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, easily worked away through the square leg region for one.
That was close. Full and attacking the stumps, with a decent amount of flight on it, Rahul looks to whack it through the covers but gets an inside edge on the leg side. One run taken.
Tossed up from Steve O'Keefe, Murali pushes it back down the ground to long off for a single.
Josh Hazlewood is seen warming up...
Fuller length delivery outside off, driven to covers for a single.

FOUR! Too full and too straight and that's been put away. Great technique from Murali Vijay. He leans ahead and wrists it between mid-wicket and mid on. Beats the chasing mid on fielder as the ball reaches the rope first.
Bumper angling down leg, Vijay crouches and lets the ball sail over him.
Keeps it in that channel outside off, and this one has kept low. The two-paced wicket is showing its nature here. Vijay leans ahead a touch and shoulders his arms to it.
Full delivery fired wide outside off, Vijay with another easy leave.
There it is again. Excellent carry for Mitchell Starc once more. Short of a length delivery angling across, good job by Murali Vijay too to let it be.
The physio is out at the centre. KL Rahul seems to have some uneasiness. Is it the heat or an upset stomach just like Renshaw? Think it's nausea that's troubling him.
Looped up and attacking the stumps, comfortably buried into the track to end the over.
FOUR! Deft from Rahul. It's darted a bit down the leg side, Rahul just tickles it fine down leg to send it across the fine leg boundary.
Stays right behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
A bit of dip on that occasion as O'Keefe gives it some decent air, it's defended solidly off the front foot.
David Warner has dropped back to long off. He was up for Murali Vijay.
Full and around off, it's driven to long off for a run.
Continues from around the wicket, Steve O'Keefe flights it up around off, Vijay leaves it alone.
Excellent line and great carry for Mitchell Starc, comes running in hard and bowls a back of a length delivery in the off stump channel, KL Rahul raises his bat and watches as the ball goes past him.
Way, way outside off, no chance the batsman has anything to do with that one.
Brings out the short one and hits the deck hard, at 148 kph, it's shaping away from the batsman, ducked and evaded.
Shortens the length on this occasion, it's banged in on a short of a length around off, KL stands back and taps it down on the track ahead.
Starc spears in another full ball, well outside off, Rahul without much foot movement looks to drive it through the covers again but fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! What a beautiful shot! Full and outside off, KL Rahul has no second thoughts about what he's going to do. Leans into the shot and drives it ever so well through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Outside off, it's played on the off side, a bit square, but to no avail. Dot ball to end the over.

Loopy and on a fullish length outside off, KL eases it down to long off for a comfortable single. The fielder should be inside the circle here, shouldn't be letting India take those easy singles. That's how you build pressure.
Nicely floats it up just outside off, just back of a driving length, inviting Rahul forward, a solid front foot block is presented.
Tossed up delivery just around off, it's kept out off the front foot.
Full delivery outside off, Rahul's drive hits Handscomb at silly mid off. No run taken.
Short and flat outside off, from around the wicket, Vijay goes back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Steve O'Keefe will bowl from the other end. Spin for Australia as well right from the beginning, much like how India started things off.
Fired in full and well outside off, dug out square on the off side for no run.

And comes back so well immediately. Always attacks the stumps, Mitchell Starc, and makes the batsman play. Full and swinging in to KL Rahul, he just about manages to bring his bat down to it and keep it out.
